progress.uid: practice__sql__a-filter__select * from employeesalary where mod ( empid , 2 ) = 1
practice__sql__a-group__select project , count ( empid ) as empprojectcount from employeesalary group by project order by empprojectcount desc
practice__sql__a-duplicates__select empid , project , salary , count ( * ) from employeesalary group by empid , project , salary having count ( * ) > 1
practice__sql__a-tables__select * into newtable from employeedetails where 1 = 0
practice__sql__a-topn__select salary from employeesalary order by salary desc limit 1 offset 2
practice__sql__a-dml__update employeesalary set salary = 20000 where empid = 2
practice__sql__aggregation__select gender , count ( * ) as count from employee group by gender
practice__sql__a-hospital__select max ( noofbeds ) as maximum , min ( noofbeds ) as minimum , avg ( noofbeds ) as average from ward

practice__sql__a-hospital__select w.wardno , w.wardtype , w.noofbeds from ward w join contains c on w.wardno = c.wardno where date ( c.admissiondate ) = curdate ( ) group by w.wardno , w.wardtype , w.noofbeds having count ( * ) > 10

practice__sql__aggregation__select b.branch_name , sum ( s.amount ) as total_expenditure from employee e join branch b on e.branch_id = b.branch_id join salary s on e.employee_id = s.employee_id group by b.branch_name

practice__sql__aggregation__select b.branch_name , count ( e.employee_id ) as total_employees from branch b join employee e on e.branch_id = b.branch_id group by b.branch_name order by total_employees desc limit 1

practice__sql__subqueries__select e.name , s.amount from employee e join salary s on e.employee_id = s.employee_id where s.amount in ( select amount from salary group by amount having count ( * ) > 1 )
practice__sql__a-joins__select distinct e.fullname from employeedetails e inner join employeedetails m on e.empid = m.managerid
practice__sql__a-subquery__select * from employeedetails e where exists ( select * from employeesalary s where e.empid = s.empid )
